model: Feature branches ship through the no-mistakes gate (review/test/document/lint) to a PR or a configured direct-delivery target. The git-level main pre-push hook and bash-safety-guard.sh block unconfigured protected-branch and bare/ambiguous pushes. push-gate (durable leases, semantic-scope approval, Dolt stack trunks) was retired; do not reintroduce its fields.

no_mistakes_branches.purpose: Default delivery path: a feature branch validated by the no-mistakes gate before it reaches the configured push target and opens/updates a PR. Drive it via the /ship skill or the no-mistakes skill.

gnhf_branches.purpose: gnhf long-run loops create and push their own working branch and ship through the same no-mistakes gate. Bounded runs use --max-iterations / --max-tokens.

scratch_branches.purpose: Opt-in remote backup, resumability, and cross-workspace handoff outside PR delivery.

yolo_branches.purpose: Reserved for an explicitly configured private policy overlay; disabled in the portable public baseline.

delivery_branches.notes: Any branch with an open PR, intended PR, or PR-base relationship is delivery scope and ships through the no-mistakes gate unless a repo-specific direct-push exception applies.
